name: ALS Luna-9
about: ALS Luna-9 (1966-006A, NII88), launched 1966 Jan 31. Its phases from GCAT: Luna, 63.856W 7.682N. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
GCAT gives a straight-in path to the ground, periapsis below the surface
